'''Dris Mosan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] small-time fence who managed to acquire a shipment of high-end security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Unable to unload them on his own, he hired additional help to act as his business partner.<ref name="Mission" />
